solutions.title: Detach segment then reverse
solutions.strategy: Walk to the requested segment, detach it, reverse those original nodes, then reconnect the reversed segment between the unchanged prefix and suffix.

timeComplexity.explanation: The algorithm walks to the range and reverses each node in that range once; all work is bounded by the list length.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only a dummy node and fixed traversal pointers are stored while original nodes are rewired.

solutions.title: In-place head insertion
solutions.strategy: Walk to the node before the segment and repeatedly move the next segment node to the segment front.

timeComplexity.explanation: The algorithm walks to the segment and performs one constant-time move for each node inside the reversed range.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A dummy node and a small fixed set of pointers are enough to rewire the segment.
